title: Visual Merchandising Checklist Form
subtitle: A practical execution checklist for visual merchandising that connects identity, observations and evidence, decision authority, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original retail-operations execution checklist for visual merchandising covering display execution and release, evidence references, authorization, escalation, operating limits, disposition, and handoff without copying a third-party form.
use_case: Use when a visual merchandising lead opens one visual merchandising record to execute required steps, record conditions, route exceptions, make a release decision, and hand off open work; closure requires a documented outcome, evidence route, responsible owner, and recipient acknowledgment.

sections.title: Merchandising checklist identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this checklist to one location, operating period, accountable owner, and review route.

blocks.label: Merchandising event scope, trigger, affected area, and prior handoff

fields.label: Visual Merchandising scope and routing context

sections.title: Merchandising readiness and execution sequence
sections.guidance: Mark each independently verified step; explain any item that cannot be completed as planned.

blocks.label: Merchandising steps
items: Campaign, plan, revision, store, and installation window linked
Fixture, sign, product, and material quantities reconciled
Existing condition and reusable components recorded
Placement, sequence, and customer sightlines checked
Price, offer, and copy source matched to approved material
Fixture stability, access path, and equipment concerns observed
Lighting, power, digital content, and device status recorded
Waste, packaging, tools, and old materials removed
Variance, substitution, and missing material approved or held
Release photos, zone owner, and removal date handed off

blocks.label: Operating boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not claim accessibility, electrical, structural, promotional, or legal compliance from this visual record. Stop and restrict a display when conditions exceed current training or authorization. Avoid identifiable customer images unless genuinely required and approved. Follow applicable merchandising, safety, accessibility, privacy, and promotional policy and route judgment to the authorized reviewer.

sections.title: Merchandising conditions and supporting evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually observed; a checked condition is a routing signal, not a conclusion.

blocks.label: Condition indicators reviewed
items: Plan, revision, price, offer, or copy mismatch
Fixture, sign, product, or hardware missing
Damaged, unstable, sharp, powered, or obstructing component
Unapproved substitution or placement
Customer path, service access, or sightline concern
Lighting, power, screen, or content failure
Install cannot finish before release window
Removal, storage, or waste route unclear

blocks.label: Observation, location, time, people affected, source, and evidence reference

fields.label: Visual Merchandising observation and evidence detail

sections.title: Merchandising exceptions, escalation, and release decision
sections.guidance: Give each exception an immediate action, owner, due point, escalation route, and disposition.

blocks.label: Exception and stop indicators
items: Approved plan or material unavailable
Substitution or placement variance requested
Price, offer, or copy requires owner review
Fixture or powered component cannot be released
Customer path or operational access is affected
Campaign release or removal date must change

sections.title: Merchandising outcome, closeout, and handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and acceptance visible.

blocks.label: Merchandising closeout controls
items: Final campaign revision and zones recorded
Release photos and evidence references linked
Price and promotional source check completed
Open material or fixture issue assigned
Store team received care and removal notes
Removal date and storage or disposal owner assigned

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
Unresolved work, customer or staff impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Visual Merchandising residual work and handoff

blocks.label: Checklist closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not a legal, safety, or professional certification.
